text:
marcel_ops: @here launching a tiny L120 dedicated pool in Bogotá (bog1) for preview customers today. Pool name: `dedicated-L120-bog1-preview`. Initial capacity: 6 cards. Goal: cut LATAM p95 for customers routed to bog1. :colombia:

anya_pm: Quick questions: reservation API, billing, and fallback policy?

marcel_ops: Reservations supported via CLI/Console; preview pricing applies. Fallback order: bog1 -> mex1 -> hosted-global. We'll tag preview reservations in billing exports.

lina_sales: I'll inform pilot accounts. Any migration CLI sample?

marcel_ops: Yes, sample below:

```
# reserve 1 card in bog1 for 7 days
rb-reserve --pool dedicated-L120-bog1-preview --size 1 --duration 7d
```

sre-bot: Health check template `bog1-l120-smoke` created.

marcel_ops: Rollout: canary starting 2026-04-10T15:00Z for 1h, then scale to preview. Pause if fallback > 8% in 15m or error-rate > 0.5%. Runbook: internal ops link.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for pool `dedicated-L120-bog1-preview` at 2026-04-10T15:00:12Z (canary).

anya_pm: Add console banner: "bog1 L120 preview may fallback to mex1 during canary" and link to migration docs.

marcel_ops: Banner added and fallback logs enabled for 48h. Monitoring anchors: token p95, fallback %, KV cache hit-rate. CE walk-through scheduled tomorrow 11:00am PT.
